results.title: Install Debian
results.text:
To install Debian, open Termux and run the command from the app.

```bash
pkg update -y && pkg install wget proot -y
andronix install debian
```

Then start it with `andronix start debian`.

output.title: Set up VNC
output.text:
Start the VNC server inside the distro:

```bash
vncserver -localhost no :1
```

Connect your VNC viewer to localhost:5901.
